sloka: शुचीनि अभ्यवहार्याणि मूलानि च फलानि च ।कांचनानि विमानानि राजतानि गृहाणि च ॥४-५१-५॥
transliteration: śucīni abhyavahāryāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।kāṁcanāni vimānāni rājatāni gṛhāṇi ca ॥4-51-5॥

translations.english: 'To whom do these golden trees resembling the rising Sun belong? For whom are these tasty roots and fruits? Whose are these manystoreyed golden houses with glittering windows adorned with silver lattices encrusted with gems?
translations.hindi: उनके साथ उनके छोटे भाई लक्ष्मण ओर उनकी पत्नी वे देही थी । जनस्थान से उनकी भार्या को बरज्ोरी रावण हर कर ले गया
